sources.institution: Lehmann, E.L. & Casella, G. (1998). Theory of Point Estimation (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Authoritative foundation for unbiasedness, CRLB, UMVUE, sufficiency, completeness, and Rao-Blackwell theory

sources.institution: Rao, C.R. (1973). Linear Statistical Inference and Its Applications (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Comprehensive treatment of information geometry, Fisher information, score identities, and efficiency

sources.institution: Casella, G. & Berger, R.L. (2002). Statistical Inference (2nd ed.)
sources.role: Classical standard for point estimation, maximum likelihood properties, interval estimation, and Bayesian inference

sources.institution: Cramér, H. (1946). Mathematical Methods of Statistics
sources.role: Pioneering mathematical derivation of information inequalities, consistency, and asymptotic efficiency of MLEs
